title: Verification Thinking and Test Planning
verification_concepts_learned: Test case: specific input with known expected output
Expected output: determined from spec before simulation
Boundary test: extreme input values (0, max)
Invalid test: inputs the design must handle gracefully

opcode_to_behavior_map.edge_case: b is unused — should not affect result

learning_notes: Verification engineers think about what can break, not just what works
A testbench must cover normal, boundary, and invalid scenarios
Zero flag must be verified explicitly — easy to forget
Division by zero is the most important edge case for ALU
